3. the directories listed in search_paths below
search_paths is intentionally EMPTY. It is the one place a machine-specific
location could be recorded and none is shipped. Prefer installing the
upstream package, or set PGATE_CONTROLLER_PATH, which leaves no trace in git.
This file lists no corpus, no ledger, no model metadata and no machine state.
Placement Gate resolves named modules only. It never enumerates a tree.
